verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud's Sift/AI tools explicitly claim to 'forecast metrics, detect anomalies, and run automated investigations... to alert on dynamic thresholds and surface likely causes' which directly matches the story, but this is a Cloud add-on feature described only via marketing docs with no independent/hands-on validation of accuracy or ease of setup. Missing for 10: independent/community corroboration of anomaly detection quality, detail on how outlier detection is configured/tuned, and confirmation it's available outside Grafana Cloud.
